description: Does another process see rows that a level inserted and deleted while it is open, after it rolls back, and after a second level commits? Both processes open the main file shared read/write in Workspaces(0). a: BeginTrans; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (30, 300, 'x30'); DELETE FROM R WHERE ID = 2 (dbFailOnError). b: reads SELECT ID, V, Z FROM R ORDER BY ID (reads it through a new snapshot as is, again after DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache)). a: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. b: reads R as before. a: BeginTrans; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (31, 310, 'x31'); CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. b: reads R as before, then again after a 7 s pause.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
